tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Change part of an existing text file: replace old_text with new_text. Read the file first and pass its version. old_text must match the file exactly (including spaces) and appear exactly once; add surrounding lines to make it unique, or set replace_all to change every occurrence.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search text files in the workspace for a word or phrase and return matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Stops after max_matches and says if there were more. Skips binary files, files over 1 MB, secret files, and folders like .git, .venv and node_modules. Use path or glob to narrow the search.

tools.name: list_folder
tools.description: List the files and folders in a workspace folder. Use "." for the workspace itself.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace (up to 200 KB). Returns its content and a version. To change the file later with write_file or edit_file, pass that version.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command (/bin/sh -c) in the workspace, e.g. tests or git status. It runs inside a sandbox: it can write only inside the workspace, has no network, cannot read the home folder or secret files, and starts with an empty environment (HOME is a temporary folder). There is no input; interactive commands will not work. Returns exit_code and output (long output keeps its start and end). The user approves every command.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new UTF-8 text file, or replace a whole existing file. To replace an existing file, read it first and pass its version. Missing folders are created. For small changes to an existing file, prefer edit_file.
